summary: A chord-harp firmware modelled on the Omnichord: black keys pick chords and the white keys act as a strum plate, with a backing chord, bass and rhythm underneath.
features: Two harp voices to mix, with adjustable sustain
Ten OM-84 rhythms with auto bass sync, sync start and chord hold
Minor, 7th and m7 by holding ENV, LFO or both; chord keys reassignable
USB and TRS MIDI in, USB out on four channels; follows MIDI clock
One screen and no patterns to program; saves settings automatically
